request.purpose: Identify GW008 season 1 World Cup final with missing date
request.sql: SELECT sm_fixture_id,home_name,away_name,home_score,away_score,penalty_home_score,penalty_away_score,competition_stage,competition_round,match_date FROM `GW008_IMC Results` WHERE game_world_id='GW008' AND competition_key='GW008|NATIONS|worldcup' AND match_date IS NULL ORDER BY sm_fixture_id DESC
